text:
elaine (OpenModelX): Hey team — we're ready to push our Citrine-7B weights to a marketplace listing. Need a quick run-through on licensing text, export compliance, and whether we can offer an optional HW bundle with HWCo drivers.

mike (partnerships): Nice — congrats. Top priorities: 1) redistribution clause (commercial vs non-commercial), 2) attribution/credits, 3) export control statement, 4) SKU for marketplace + hardware bundle.

ana (ana (legal)): tagging in legal. Quick note: Open-source license + commercial redistribution are separate. We need the exact upstream license file and an exporter attestation. Can OpenModelX provide: 1) license file, 2) provenance/weights origin, 3) any export control self-declaration?

elaine (OpenModelX): Yep — attaching links in the partner portal. We have an MIT-derived license on model code, weights are redistributed under a permissive grant but with an export restriction paragraph. We'll paste exact snippet later.

shay (product): On marketplace packaging: recommend two SKUs — "citrine-7b" (cloud hosted, Redwood-managed) and "citrine-7b-hwco-bundle" (dedicated + HWCo optimized). The bundle should list supported instance types and quantization profile. Example snippet:```json
{
  "sku": "citrine-7b-hwco-bundle",
  "includes": ["model:7b","hwco-driver:v2","optimized-kernels"],
  "deployment_modes": ["hosted","dedicated"]
}
```

mike (partnerships): For pricing and revenue share, do we want a fixed rev-share or tiered? HWCo prefers a per-instance uplift. Jordan, do you have constraints?

jordan (HWCo): We can support a 10–15% uplift on official HW bundles; prefer a tiered split if committed capacity > X. Also need a binary compatibility statement for our driver — we can't redistribute modified binaries without a signed SOW.

ana (ana (legal)): Noted. We'll draft a redistribution clause that: a) requires provider attestation of origin b) allows Redwood to package binaries under an SOW c) includes export-control language and customer-level indemnity limits. I'll post a redline by EOD.

mike (partnerships): Timeline suggestion: legal redline by EOD, marketplace SKU + assets by Wed, partner announcement draft by Fri. Launch window target: 2 weeks after sign-off to coordinate press + partner channels.

elaine (OpenModelX): Works for us. Quick question: can we include a sample inference benchmark and latency numbers for the HW bundle on the listing?

shay (product): Yes — include controlled benchmarks with clear config. We'll add a "tested config" section on the SKU page and a note: "results may vary; see docs." Keep it non-comparative.

ops-bot: reminder: please run export-control-checklist script before uploading weights: `./scripts/check_export_controls.sh citrine-7b`

ana (ana (legal)): FYI, partner announcement copy must avoid implying Redwood endorsement of training data. We'll add a line about "partner-provided model" and link to OpenModelX license.

mike (partnerships): I'll coordinate with marketing for the joint announcement cadence. @elaine, can you confirm embargo/PR window and preferred channels (blog, marketplace spotlight, HWCo co-post)?

elaine (OpenModelX): Prefer simultaneous blog + HWCo tweet + marketplace spotlight. Embargo OK for June 10 — we need final assets by June 7.

mike (partnerships): Cool. Action items: Ana -> legal redline (EOD). Shay -> SKU + benchmark template (Wed). Jordan -> confirm bundle uplift & SOW language (Tom). Elaine -> provide license & provenance links + final PR contact. I'll slot announcement with marketing once redlines are in. :thumbsup:

jordan (HWCo): Will confirm uplift and SOW constraints by tomorrow morning.

elaine (OpenModelX): Thanks all — uploading artifacts to partner portal now.

mike (partnerships): Great thread. Filing checklist in /shared/partnerships/citrine-onboard.

ops-bot: checklist created: /shared/partnerships/citrine-onboard/checklist.md
